note_generale: Les trois affirmations judiciaires (proces brevets ClearCorrect/Straumann, TVA britannique, IPR devant le PTAB) sont exactes au mot pres, y compris leurs nuances favorables a Align. Un seul defaut, mineur, sur la description d'une baisse de ventes de scanners.

controles.affirmation: Le segment Systems and Services a recule de 20,9 M$ sur 6 mois (-5,3%), dont -46 M$ dus au glissement de mix et -28 M$ a la baisse des ventes de scanners iTero
controles.verbatim_source: "For the six months ended June 30, 2026, Systems and Services net revenues decreased by $21 million compared to the same period in 2025, primarily due to decrease of $46 million from mix shift to lower-priced products, and $28 million from lower scanner wand sales. These decreases were partially offset by higher system volume of $35 million and an increase of $18 million from higher non-systems sales and favorable foreign exchange."
controles.correction_proposee: Deux corrections. 1) Les 28 M$ portent sur les 'scanner wand sales' (ventes de tetes de scanner / mises a niveau), pas sur les ventes de scanners iTero en general. 2) L'ATT omet les compensations explicitement citees dans la meme phrase : +35 M$ de volume de systemes (le volume de scanners est donc en HAUSSE) et +18 M$ de ventes non-systemes et de change. Presenter -46 et -28 sans ces deux postes suggere un recul bien superieur aux 21 M$ reels.

controles.affirmation: Proces brevets : invalidation avant proces du brevet 8 038 444, jugement en faveur des Defendeurs sur le brevet 10 791 936, verdict du 2 juillet 2026 constatant la contrefacon de quatre brevets Align tout en les jugeant invalides pour insuffisance de description ; Align l'emporte sur les demandes reconventionnelles antitrust et fraude aux brevets ; six IPR en cours devant le PTAB avec decision au plus tard le 9 novembre 2026
controles.verbatim_source: "On July 2, the jury returned a verdict in Align's favor on the Defendants' antitrust and unfair competition claims. The jury also entered a verdict in Align's favor on Defendants' claim that Align procured certain patents by fraud. The jury found that the Defendants infringed the asserted claims of four of Align's patents (US Patent Nos. 10,973,613; 11,154,384, 11,648,090, and 11,648,091)... The jury found that the asserted claims of US Patent Nos. 10,973,613; 11,154,384, 11,648,090, and 11,648,091 were invalid for lack of enablement. Before trial, the District Court judge found that the asserted claims 1, 2, 11 and 39 of US Patent No. 8,038,444 (the treatment planning patent) were invalid under 35 U.S.C. 101 and during the trial, granted Defendants' motion for judgment as a matter of law on the asserted claims of US Patent No. 10,791,936 (the scanner patent)." ; "the PTAB issued decisions instituting proceedings on the remaining six IPRs. We anticipate that the final decisions from the PTAB on each IPR will be issued no later than November 9, 2026."

controles.affirmation: Le 7 juillet 2026 l'Upper Tribunal a juge que les gouttieres ne sont pas des protheses dentaires et restent soumises a la TVA britannique ; provision de 37,5 M$ interets compris ; Align avait cesse de facturer la TVA des aout 2025 et qualifie la perte de probable et raisonnablement estimable
controles.verbatim_source: "On April 24, 2025, the Tax Tribunal issued a ruling in our favor indicating that clear aligners are 'dental prostheses for the purposes of VAT'... In August 2025, we stopped charging VAT to our United Kingdom ('UK') customers... On July 7, 2026, the Upper Tribunal released its decision and held that aligners are not 'dental prostheses' for the purposes of VAT and are therefore subject to VAT in the UK. Based on the information available, we determined that a loss is probable and reasonably estimable and recorded an estimated liability of approximately $ 37.5 million, inclusive of estimated interest... We intend to exhaust all available appeals and vigorously defend our position"

controles.affirmation: Marge operationnelle Clear Aligner de 37,0% (2023) a 35,4% (2024) puis 31,9% (2025) ; marge totale 16,7% / 15,2% / 13,5% ; Systems and Services 28,9% a 38,8%
controles.verbatim_source: 10-K FY2025 : "Operating margin % 31.9 % 35.4 % [Clear Aligner] 35.4 % 37.0 %" ; "Systems and Services ... Operating margin % 38.8 % 35.0 % 35.0 % 28.9 %" ; "Total ... Operating margin % 13.5 % 15.2 % 15.2 % 16.7 %" ; "Total operating margin percentage decreased in 2025 compared to the same period in 2024 primarily due to lower gross margin and higher restructuring and other charges, offset by lower legal settlement loss."
controles.correction_proposee: Exact. Nuance de rigueur : la citation retenue comme preuve explique la marge TOTALE ; la phrase specifique au segment Clear Aligner est distincte et ne mentionne pas la restructuration : "Clear Aligner Operating margin percentage decreased in 2025 ... primarily due to a decrease in gross margin and an increase in marketing and media expense and credit card transaction fees." L'ATT fusionne les deux explications.

controles.affirmation: CA Clear Aligner de 3 245,4 M$ en 2025 contre 3 247 M$ en 2021 ; +0,5% en 2025 ; 2 611,3 milliers de cas expedies en 2025
controles.verbatim_source: 10-K FY2025 : "Clear Aligner revenues of $3,245.4 million, an increase of 0.5% year-over-year" ; "Total case volume 2,611.3 2,493.7 117.5 4.7 %" ; 10-K FY2023 (note segments) : "Year Ended December 31, 2023 2022 2021 Net revenues Clear Aligner $ 3,199,329 $ 3,072,585 $ 3,247,080"

controles.affirmation: Au S1 2026, le CA Clear Aligner augmente de 125 M$, dont 26 M$ effaces par une baisse du prix de vente moyen liee aux remises et au glissement vers des produits et pays moins chers
controles.verbatim_source: "For the six months ended June 30, 2026, Clear Aligner net revenues increased by $125 million compared to the same period in 2025, primarily due to an increase in volume and favorable foreign exchange rates, which increased net revenues by $102 million and $49 million, respectively. These increases were partially offset by higher discounts and product mix shift to lower-priced countries and products resulting in a decrease in net revenues of $26 million."

controles.affirmation: 37,0 M$ de charges de restructuration au T4 2024 puis 40,9 M$ en 2025 ; effectif a 20 435 employes au 30 juin 2026, -4,9% sur un an ; le plan 2025 est termine et aucune charge supplementaire n'est attendue
controles.verbatim_source: "2024 Restructuring In the fourth quarter of 2024, we incurred approximately $ 37.0 million in restructuring expenses" ; "In the third quarter of 2025, we initiated a plan... We incurred approximately $ 40.9 million in restructuring expenses... We have completed the 2025 restructuring plan and incurred approximately $ 40.2 million in total restructuring expenses. We do not expect to incur additional restructuring expenses" ; "Number of employees was 20,435 as of June 30, 2026, a decrease of 4.9% year-over-year primarily due to workforce reduction associated with the 2025 restructuring plan."
controles.correction_proposee: Exact. A noter que le cout total definitif du plan 2025 est de 40,2 M$ selon le 10-Q, contre 40,9 M$ initialement engages ; l'ATT retient le chiffre le plus eleve.

controles.affirmation: Les nouveaux traitements orthodontiques reculent depuis quatre annees consecutives, poussant les praticiens vers les bagues et fils metalliques, phenomene plus prononce au T2 2025
controles.verbatim_source: 10-K FY2025, Item 7 : "patient traffic growth has been uneven for many doctors, with orthodontic starts down for four consecutive years... We believe this has resulted in an increase in orthodontic starts using wires and brackets in lieu of clear aligners that was more pronounced in the second quarter of 2025."
